source_snapshot.procedure: Press Enter to enter the selected item after recipe verification and log clearing; collect results/photos and unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek queries SMBIOS Type 42 with dmidecode, which belongs to a different workbook row sharing the same code and cannot test an Enter-key action in a pre-OS interface.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that pressing Enter activates the currently highlighted selectable item in the intended POST/BIOS/pre-OS interface and produces the owner-defined response.
original_test_intent.target: The exact owner-designated screen and highlighted item on the SUT's local or approved remote pre-OS console for source row 355; not the separate SMBIOS Type 42 case that reuses this code.
original_test_intent.scope: One observed Enter-key selection on a defined safe item, including the highlighted pre-state, key action, resulting screen/state and clean exit. No unrelated SMBIOS query can substitute for the interaction.
original_test_intent.operation: Open the approved pre-OS screen in a controlled boot window, record the target item and current state, have an operator press Enter through a validated physical keyboard or approved remote KVM, record the exact response, cancel or restore any unapproved pending change, then verify normal boot and configuration state.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One selection observation; the source gives 30 attended and machine minutes but no required dwell time or repetition count.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Enter activates only the highlighted approved item, the expected menu/action occurs without stuck, ignored or misdirected input, no unapproved setting is committed, and the SUT exits to the approved final state.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Exact source_ref and board/BIOS build, console path, named screen/item and expected response, timestamped before/action/after visual record, any before/after setting comparison, exit/restoration evidence and normal boot health.
ambiguities: The source does not identify the BIOS/pre-OS screen, selectable item, expected resulting screen/state or whether the item commits a change.
The source does not say whether physical keyboard/display is mandatory; an approved remote KVM may exercise the same pre-OS key path if its input and visual capture are validated.
The same code is reused by a separate SMBIOS Type 42 row, so code-only lookup can attach the wrong command and purpose.
source_conflicts: The DeepSeek dmidecode Type 42 command conflicts with this row's POST/General Hotkey Enter-selection procedure and was apparently inherited from the other row sharing the code.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects the unrelated dmidecode command, keeps the interactive selection manual, requires a safe named target and protects configuration/boot state. It unnecessarily requires a physical keyboard/display even though the source does not exclude an approved remote KVM, and it does not make the duplicate-code row isolation part of the execution contract.

applicable_history.decision: Two distinct entries use Wistron-BIOS-00022-V003: Functionality row 355 is Enter-key selection, while a later row is SMBIOS Type 42. Source row and variant identity therefore take precedence over code-only lookup.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The test remains MANUAL ONLY because an operator must observe and judge an interactive pre-OS key action. V3 allows either validated physical console or approved remote KVM, locks execution to row 355, and prevents the duplicate code's SMBIOS command from contaminating this case.

available_now: The row clearly defines an Enter-key selection intent in the POST/General Hotkey area.
The action can be documented visually and supported by read-only board/BIOS/configuration inventory.
The duplicate-code conflict is locatable by sheet, source_row and case_variant_id.
missing_inputs: Exact pre-OS interface, screen, highlighted item and expected response
Whether the item is non-destructive or, if it stages a change, the approved cancel/restoration path
Approved physical-console or remote-KVM path, boot/maintenance window and operator
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BIOS/test owner supplies the exact menu item, expected response and safe exit; the lab owner supplies a validated console path and operator; the system/workload owner approves the boot interruption.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect board identity, BIOS version/build and relevant configuration from OS/BMC where available, preserving current logs
Verify the console can display POST/BIOS and capture evidence without sending keys; confirm this contract is bound to Functionality row 355 rather than the duplicate SMBIOS row
prohibited_until_closed: Do not send Enter on an unnamed item, enter a production boot window, commit settings, reset/reboot beyond the approved sequence or clear logs
Do not run dmidecode Type 42 as completion evidence and do not select a row by code alone
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The approved run card names the exact screen/item/expected response and safe exit; console and operator are ready; before/after capture works; any setting/boot impact and recovery are approved; the record retains the full source key.

revision_candidate.purpose: Verify that Enter activates the owner-designated highlighted item in the intended pre-OS interface and produces the specified response without committing an unauthorized setting.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact board and BIOS build in a controlled boot window, using a validated local keyboard/display or owner-approved remote KVM that exposes the intended POST/BIOS screen and records visual evidence.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the named screen and selectable item for Functionality row 355 / case variant 56ff73c8e8fd32dc. The same code's SMBIOS Type 42 row is out of scope.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Board/BIOS build, exact screen/item, expected Enter response, console path, safe item or cancel/restoration method, approved boot window, operator and visual evidence destination.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture the highlighted target and current state; have the operator press Enter once through the validated console; capture the resulting screen/state; verify the response against the run card; cancel or restore any unapproved pending change; exit and verify normal boot/configuration.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct source variant and SUT selected; expected response documented; console input/video proven; item and restoration path assessed safe; boot interruption approved; current BIOS/configuration context and logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Source key and board/build; console type; timestamped image/video of the highlighted item before input, Enter action record and resulting screen/state; before/after setting status; clean exit and normal boot/health evidence.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The board-specific BIOS/POST menu specification or engineer-approved run card naming the screen, item and correct Enter-key response.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never press Enter on an unidentified item, commit an unapproved BIOS/boot/security change, clear logs, improvise a recovery action or substitute SMBIOS output for interactive evidence.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: The BIOS/system owner approves the target, expected response, boot window and restoration path; a human operator performs/observes the key action and judges visual correctness.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The key action and visual usability judgment are manual. An agent may collect supporting inventory, coordinate capture and verify post-boot state but cannot replace the required observed interaction with an OS query.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: If an unexpected dialog/change/reset appears, stop further input, capture the screen, use only the approved cancel/restore route, preserve logs and recover normal boot under BIOS-owner control before retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong source variant, undefined screen/item/result, unvalidated console, missing operator/window/restoration, unexpected setting prompt, reset/write request, misdirected input, loss of visual feedback or inability to return to the approved boot/configuration state.

identified_defects: Code-only matching attached the unrelated SMBIOS Type 42 command to this pre-OS key test.
The source lacks the exact selected item and expected response, so an unqualified Enter action is unsafe and not objectively judgeable.
V2 turns the absence of a specified console into a physical-console requirement even though a validated remote KVM can preserve the same intent.
reason_for_change: Preserve the manual interactive intent while removing an unjustified physical-presence restriction and making source-row identity mandatory in a known duplicate-code collision.

new_technical_evidence.title: Round 02 Functionality review records
new_technical_evidence.supports: The code appears once for POST/General Hotkey Select and again for SMBIOS Type 42, proving code alone is not a unique case key.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The exact BIOS menu item and acceptable console method remain owner inputs.

removed_ambiguities: Binds the contract to the sheet/row/variant rather than the duplicated code.
Allows a validated remote KVM without claiming it is available on every platform.
Defines the minimal before/action/after evidence and rejects dmidecode as a proxy.
resolved_blockers: Physical presence is not an inherent requirement if an approved pre-OS remote console provides validated input and visual evidence; the action remains manual.
remaining_blockers: Execution cannot begin until the exact safe item, expected response, console/operator, boot window and restoration method are defined.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains V2's correct manual classification and no-proxy rule while adding duplicate-row isolation and supporting an equivalent approved remote-console workflow instead of imposing an unsupported physical-console-only constraint.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator kept the exact pre-OS screen, highlighted item and one Enter action, rejected OS substitution and required proof that no unauthorized change was committed.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 355 requires pressing Enter to enter a selected POST/General Hotkey item and judging whether that function key works.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly restores interactive selection but assumes physical console and does not encode protection from the same-code SMBIOS row.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Use only a named safe item and approved console/operator, capture before/action/after visually, avoid commits and recover normal boot; never use Type 42 output as completion.
